title: Vanilla Forever
description: A modpack designed to last across major Minecraft updates.
body:
![Vanilla Forever logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad27ca57aaab529abb1ea68c46af929f16e144e9.png)

Looking for an optimised modpack that you can use with your forever world?

Then look no further than **Vanilla Forever**! This modpack improves FPS along with adding visual and sound enhancements, a dark mode UI, mob animations, and creator tools like Flashback and Status.

The modpack is designed to keep the core of a Minecraft world compatible across major game updates. This means **no new blocks** are added. Ideally, you'll be able to transfer a world from this modpack to a completely vanilla instance without the risk of world corruption.
